title: "frame_ids cannot start with a '/'" in ROS 2 tf2: why /map publishes fine but fails in lookup_transform, can_transform returning False, timeouts and empty frame IDs, measured
excerpt: tf2 stored a published /map as map, but lookup_transform('/map') raised InvalidArgumentException on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical. can_transform returned False instead, and a 2 s timeout ran out before the error. Only one slash is stripped. Lyrical rejects old static_transform_publisher arguments.
